description: This Java source file contains integration tests for uploading telemetry data to an Eclipse Hono CoAP adapter. It includes test setup, constants, and a specific test method for verifying telemetry message uploads using QoS 1 over CoAP protocol. The class 'TelemetryCoapIT' extends a base test class and utilizes the JUnit testing framework along with Vert.x for asynchronous testing.

classes.name: TelemetryCoapIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing telemetry data upload via CoAP to Eclipse Hono, extending base CoAP test functionalities and performing integration testing with specific focus on QoS 1 message delivery.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer for a specific tenant, utilizing an application client factory.

methods.name: getPutResource
methods.description: Generates the URI resource path for PUT requests, parameterized by tenant and device ID.

methods.name: getPostResource
methods.description: Returns the URI resource path for POST requests.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Specifies the CoAP message type used in the test, which is NON (non-confirmable).

methods.name: testUploadUsingQoS1
methods.description: A JUnit test case verifying successful telemetry message upload over CoAP with QoS 1, ensuring integration with other messaging protocols.
